card.name: Superlatives in record statistics
card.fires_on: Superlative words like largest, lowest, highest, warmest, worst after 'the' or 'its' when a statistic is described as a record. Mostly in news or climate and economic reports.

modes.label: Superlative adjective
modes.description: The superlative itself, naming a record high or low for a measure.
modes.example: The percentage of the working age population that is participating in the job market is at its<< lowest>> rate in 30 years.

modes.label: Record wording after the superlative
modes.description: Words like record or level that follow or extend the superlative claim.
modes.example: Disappearing Arctic sea ice — summer ice extent was at its lowest<< level>> in recorded history in 20
